description.value: Victoria Harbour House is a family-owned steak and seafood restaurant that has been a local favourite since 1980 and has been voted one of the best restaurants in Victoria. The menu features modern regional dishes with seasonal flavours, including a full dinner and drinks menu alongside house-made desserts. The restaurant accommodates walk-in diners as well as reservations for larger parties, making it a solid option for a sit-down meal on a touring itinerary.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content for victoriaharbourhouse.com confirms this is a real, operating steak and seafood restaurant at 607 Oswego Street, Victoria, with phone (250) 386-1244 matching what the website lists. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi, takeout, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the site. A name discrepancy exists: OSM records 'Harbour House Restaurant' while the website consistently uses 'Victoria Harbour House' / 'Victoria Harbour House Restaurant'.
